title: feat: expand publisher access request
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a required one-or-both selector for public community models and managed agents.
- Generalizes the existing access form while keeping its stable issue-template URL.
- Links the Agents section to the same publisher-access request flow.
- Documents co-author attribution for applicants in future allowlist PRs.

Checks:
- `biome check --write enter.pollinations.ai/frontend/src/components/community-endpoints/community-endpoints.tsx`
- Parsed the issue-form YAML with Ruby
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: One form, more pollen
gist.blurb: The publisher gate grew a second door. Community model publishers and managed-agent builders now meet at the same pleasantly boring form.
gist.summary: Generalized the stable community publisher-access issue form so applicants can request access for public community models, managed agents, or both, and linked the Agents section to that flow.
gist.impact: Builders can now use one clear request path to publish community models and managed agents, while future allowlist PRs can credit applicant co-authors.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly garden steward holding a clipboard beside one cozy gateway that splits into two clearly labeled paths: a code-flower garden for public community models and a small retro robot workshop for managed agents. The shared request form is the central object, with the Monitor Robot eagerly pointing at both paths and vines connecting them to show a unified application flow.
